consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of git diff --name-only and git diff -z --no-renames --name-only (the two name listings the diff-touches precondition in src/gates/run.ts has read), captured 2026-09-30 with git 2.43.0 by the M6-P3 fix round 2 implementer against the scratch repositories test/gates.test.ts stages in stageDiffTouchesRepo (a rename of src/a.ts to lib/a.ts, and an edit of a src/ file whose name carries U+00E9); the base sha is spelled <base>. The named tests stage the repositories again, re-run both commands and require git's live stdout to equal the recorded stdout before they run the gate. Required by rule (f) because every member mutates src/gates/run.ts, which the spawn/parse derivation matches.
